summary: Implemented the adapter half of PRD_VIEWER_CLARITY. Capture: workflow/checks.py verify_revision, worker phase only, after the clean-worktree check and before setup/run_lane_commands, copies each changed regular text file (UTF-8, no NUL) as a `file` artifact with repo-relative `path`; other paths go to files_not_captured with binary/too_large/missing/budget; caps FILE_CAPTURE_LIMIT=512 KiB and PACKET_FILE_CAPTURE_LIMIT=8 MiB; candidate phase captures and lists nothing. recheck_packet verifies file artifacts by sha256 like every artifact (existing evaluate_worker loop); verification.py also rejects file/uncaptured paths that are not distinct changed files. Contract: contracts/workflow/v1.ts artifact kind gains `file`, optional `path` (relativePath) required exactly when kind is file (zod refine + exported JSON Schema anyOf), optional files_not_captured; contract_version stays 1.0.0; schemas regenerated; validateWorkerResult cross-field rule; READMEs, examples.ts and contract.test.ts updated in both families (projects examples gain servedWorkerResult). Server: server/projects.ts registers `file` artifacts, serves them as text/plain; charset=utf-8 inline, passes files_not_captured through. Tests: new workflow/test_checks.py (capture-text-files, capture-before-checks, tampered-file-artifact, caps/text rule, budget, symlink, schema path rule, cross-field); server/projects.test.ts served-files plus a malformed-files test. Docs: workflow/RUNBOOK.md, workflow/CHEATSHEET.md, features/project-workflows/README.md. Checks run in this worktree (after npm ci): workflow unit suite 204 tests OK (final run; two earlier full runs each had one different test_automatic failure under machine load, the affected classes and the whole test_automatic module (94 tests) then passed alone); npm run test:contracts 20/20 pass; npm run test:unit 130/130 pass; npx tsx --test server/projects.test.ts 37/37 pass (not part of test:unit); npm run build exit 0. No commit, push or merge.
open_assumptions: Artifact shape: a single object with kind enum incl. `file` and optional `path` (TS type `path?: string`), enforced by zod refine and a JSON Schema `anyOf` rather than a discriminated union, because a union broke the ui lane's tests/project-workflows/fixtures.ts type-check (npm run build). A non-file artifact carrying `path` is invalid.

Regenerating schemas also changed contracts/workflow/event.schema.json and contracts/projects/reviewResult.schema.json (both embed artifactSchema): additive, no version bump; the review diff must still be a `patch`.
`missing` also covers changed paths that are not regular files inside the worktree (symbolic links, never followed; submodules), in addition to deleted or renamed-away paths.
`budget`: a file that would take the packet's captured total past 8 MiB is listed as budget; later smaller files that still fit are captured (changed-file order).
Worker-phase results always carry files_not_captured (possibly empty); candidate-phase and pre-capture results omit it. The served result omits it when the packet lacks it.

Added cross-field rules (TS validateWorkerResult and Python evaluate_worker): every file-artifact path and files_not_captured path must be a distinct entry of changed_files; a violating packet is blocked / served as RESULT_INVALID.
server/projects.test.ts is not in `npm run test:unit`; it was run directly with tsx.
Ran `npm ci` in the worktree to install node_modules (gitignored; no manifest changes).
